rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday way to describe two people making up and restoring friendly relations.

example.english: I had a reconciliation with Ah Ming the day after we fell out.
example.traditional: 我同阿明鬧完交，第二日就和好喇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 tung4 aa3 ming4 naau6 jyun4 gaau1 dai6 ji6 jat6 zau6 wo4 hou2 laa3

rows.note: Use this for a formal or serious reconciliation, especially between disputing parties or organizations.

example.english: The two companies finally reached a reconciliation after several rounds of talks.
example.traditional: 兩間公司經過多輪談判，終於達成和解。
example.jyutping: loeng5 gaan1 gung1 si1 ging1 gwo3 do1 leon4 taam4 pun3 zung1 jyu1 daat6 sing4 wo4 gaai2
